channel.title: Acadie.sol — Signals
channel.description: Acadian community signals — releases, events, calls for participation, and civic opportunities. One feed, sovereign connection.

item.title: 🎵 New Release: Rivière Rouge — MR LP
item.description: New single inspired by the parallel droughts hitting Acadian and Basque coastal communities. Folk-electronic. Available on all platforms. CC BY-NC-SA.

item.title: 🎪 Festival de la Pêche — Booking Acadian Musicians
item.description: Seeking Acadian folk musicians for July 12–14 lineup. Budget $1500–2500 per act. Maritime-based preferred. Deadline: June 20.

item.title: 🏛️ Consultation: New Cultural Center — Moncton
item.description: City of Moncton seeking public input on proposed Acadian cultural center. Town hall July 3 at 7pm, Centre Aquarena. Online submission open until July 15. Your voice shapes what gets built.

item.title: 🎵 Marie Boudreau — Available for Summer Festival Bookings
item.description: Singer-songwriter based in Moncton. Acadian folk with contemporary arrangements. Available July–August, Maritime range. Willing to travel within 300km. Contact via website.

item.title: 🤝 SOS Pêcheurs — Shoreline Cleanup Volunteer Call
item.description: Community shoreline cleanup June 14, 9am, Pointe-du-Chêne. Bring gloves and boots. Families welcome. Lunch provided by local sponsors. Signal group for coordination: link on site.

item.title: 🤝 Weekly Kitchen Table Meetup — Lafayette
item.description: Every Tuesday 7pm at Maison Acadienne. No agenda, no pressure. Come talk about what you wish you knew sooner. We listen, we write it down, we publish it. Remote? DM for Signal link. Stewards in other towns welcome.

item.title: 🗞️ Acadian Weekly Briefing — 2026-06-09
item.description: Nouvelle-Aquitaine deploys satellite WiFi across rural communities. Basque Country launches new cultural communication strategy. Festival de la Pêche booking call open. Moncton cultural center consultation announced.
